title: Finite delivery-fee rules with an unresolved overlap
request: Create a draft decision-table test design from the stated finite rules. Do not execute tests, call tools, write to external systems, invent precedence, or report a pass/fail result. Return only the common response envelope.

known_facts.text: Customer plan is either MEMBER or STANDARD; destination is either DOMESTIC or INTERNATIONAL.
STANDARD with INTERNATIONAL destination is unsupported and excluded from the legal rule universe.
MEMBER with DOMESTIC destination has a waived delivery fee.
STANDARD with DOMESTIC destination has a delivery fee of 5 USD.
MEMBER with INTERNATIONAL destination has a delivery fee of 15 USD.
A second rule assigns MEMBER with DOMESTIC destination a delivery fee of 8 USD; no precedence is stated.

scope: Finite decision-table design draft only; preserve excluded, conflicting, and unresolved behaviour without execution or approval.

checks.question: Provide the legal finite condition combinations and their classification as a JSON observation.
Provide source fact IDs that make the MEMBER/DOMESTIC outcome unresolved as a sorted unique string-set observation.
